author: bilalgs
quote:
Its neither a masterpiece nor a AAA Game. On the other hand it's also not a boring or a bad game. Alien Isolation is levels better than this.

The most disappointing thing is the predictability of the Aliens. Every 1-2 minute or so they come and you fight them. You dont have the chance to discover the station without getting attacked. You can not hide or play stealth to avoid them temporarly, to discover the station and get deep into the feeling being on the station. While reading a massage on the computer, you automatically prepare yourself to kill the next incoming Aliens because you KNOW that they are coming every 1 2 minute. The survival and exploration feeling is then automatically gone. No surprise feeling anymore. 

The storytelling is great. The story however is only half, because its part 1. That ****. Feels like a half game. The endboss is disappointing. I expected a good final, like killing the mother Alien in the Movie "Aliens". Sounddesign is ok-good but nowhere close to the sounddesign from Alien Isolation. 

Do i recommend it? Yes, i liked the game and had pleasure. Will play the game a second time. I gave Alien Isolation a 10/10 and this a 6-7/10

author: bilalgs
quote:
Its 2020 now and by far the best Game i ever played and experienced!
The atmosphere, the sounddesign, the graphics are so so stunning!
You are going to a story which in the opening of the game is presented so mystic and dark and full of questions...
What is happening?
What kind of danger is in there?
Are you going to find answers to the disappear of your mom?
This is soooooooo SATISFYING and well implemented!
This is exactly what a storytelling is about.
The progression of the storyline is also so so good! Step by step you are exploring the spaceship and the danger. Slowly you get a sense what it could be. It hypes you hours until you finally see the xenomorph first time and now you FEEL the danger! After that you realise that you have to escape, you have to survive, because you now, the xenomorph is the perfect hunting creature and its better than you, smarter then you and can kill you every damn second of the game!
That is, what Alien Isolation makes such a MASTERPIECE!
10/10
